description: Plan stale and merged branch cleanup from branch data: a keep / review / delete decision with a reason per branch, plus the delete commands. Lists only; deletes nothing.

branches.description: Branches to plan for (at least one)

current.description: True for the currently checked-out branch (optional, default false)

last_commit_days_ago.description: Whole days since the branch's last commit (at least 0)

merged.description: True when the branch is merged into the default branch (optional, default false)

protected.description: True for protected branches (optional, default false)

upstream_gone.description: True when the branch's upstream is gone (optional, default false)

default_branch.description: Default branch name; it is never planned for deletion (optional, default "main")

stale_days.description: A branch is stale at this many days since its last commit (optional, default 90)

name: plan_branch_cleanup
